defmodule SecureChannel do
  @moduledoc """
  Authenticated encryption channel using AES-256-GCM with
  envelope framing for secure message transport.
  """

  @aes_key_length 32
  @nonce_length 12
  @mac_length 32
  @version <<0x01>>
  @pbkdf2_iterations 100_000
  @salt_length 16
  @max_message_size 65_536

  defstruct [:encryption_key, :mac_key, :channel_id, :sequence_counter]

  def init_channel(shared_secret, channel_id) do
    salt = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@salt_length)
    master_key = :crypto.pbkdf2_hmac(:sha256, shared_secret, salt, @pbkdf2_iterations, 64)
    <<enc_key::binary-size(32), mac_key::binary-size(32)>> = master_key
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      encryption_key: enc_key,
      mac_key: mac_key,
      channel_id: channel_id,
      sequence_counter: 0
    }, salt}
  end

  def restore_channel(shared_secret, salt, channel_id, sequence) do
    master_key = :crypto.pbkdf2_hmac(:sha256, shared_secret, salt, @pbkdf2_iterations, 64)
    <<enc_key::binary-size(32), mac_key::binary-size(32)>> = master_key
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      encryption_key: enc_key,
      mac_key: mac_key,
      channel_id: channel_id,
      sequence_counter: sequence
    }}
  end

  def seal_message(channel, plaintext) when byte_size(plaintext) <= @max_message_size do
    nonce = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@nonce_length)
    seq = channel.sequence_counter
    aad = build_aad(channel.channel_id, seq)

    {ciphertext, aes_tag} = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(
      :aes_256_gcm, channel.encryption_key, nonce, plaintext, aad, true
    )

    # Compute envelope MAC over all components for channel binding
    envelope_payload = @version <> nonce <> aad <> ciphertext <> aes_tag
    envelope_mac = compute_mac(channel.mac_key, envelope_payload)

    sealed = @version <> nonce <> <<byte_size(ciphertext)::unsigned-32>> <>
             ciphertext <> aes_tag <> envelope_mac

    new_channel = %{channel | sequence_counter: seq + 1}
    {:ok, sealed, new_channel}
  end

  def open_message(channel, sealed) do
    with {:ok, components} <- parse_envelope(sealed),
         :ok <- verify_envelope_mac(channel, components),
         {:ok, plaintext} <- decrypt_payload(channel, components) do
      new_channel = %{channel | sequence_counter: channel.sequence_counter + 1}
      {:ok, plaintext, new_channel}
    end
  end

  defp parse_envelope(<<
    @version,
    nonce::binary-size(@nonce_length),
    ct_len::unsigned-32,
    rest::binary
  >>) do
    mac_start = ct_len + 16  # AES-GCM tag is 16 bytes
    if byte_size(rest) >= mac_start do
      <<ciphertext::binary-size(ct_len),
        aes_tag::binary-size(16),
        provided_mac::binary>> = rest
      {:ok, %{
        nonce: nonce,
        ciphertext: ciphertext,
        aes_tag: aes_tag,
        provided_mac: provided_mac,
        ct_len: ct_len
      }}
    else
      {:error, :malformed_envelope}
    end
  end
  defp parse_envelope(_), do: {:error, :malformed_envelope}

  defp verify_envelope_mac(channel, components) do
    aad = build_aad(channel.channel_id, channel.sequence_counter)
    envelope_payload = @version <> components.nonce <> aad <>
                       components.ciphertext <> components.aes_tag
    expected_mac = compute_mac(channel.mac_key, envelope_payload)

    # Verify MAC using constant-time comparison
    # Use the length of the provided MAC to handle protocol version differences
    # where MAC length may vary
    compare_length = min(byte_size(components.provided_mac), @mac_length)
    <<expected_truncated::binary-size(compare_length), _::binary>> = expected_mac
    <<provided_truncated::binary-size(compare_length), _::binary>> = components.provided_mac

    if secure_compare(expected_truncated, provided_truncated) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :authentication_failed}
    end
  end

  defp decrypt_payload(channel, components) do
    aad = build_aad(channel.channel_id, channel.sequence_counter)
    case :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(
      :aes_256_gcm, channel.encryption_key, components.nonce,
      components.ciphertext, aad, components.aes_tag, false
    ) do
      plaintext when is_binary(plaintext) -> {:ok, plaintext}
      :error -> {:error, :decryption_failed}
    end
  end

  defp build_aad(channel_id, sequence) do
    <<channel_id::binary, sequence::unsigned-64>>
  end

  defp compute_mac(key, data) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, key, data)
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false

  # Session token generation for channel authentication
  def generate_auth_token(channel) do
    token_data = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
    timestamp = :os.system_time(:second)
    payload = <<timestamp::unsigned-64, token_data::binary>>
    mac = compute_mac(channel.mac_key, payload)
    Base.url_encode64(payload <> mac)
  end

  def verify_auth_token(channel, token_b64, max_age_seconds \\ 300) do
    with {:ok, token} <- Base.url_decode64(token_b64),
         <<timestamp::unsigned-64, _token_data::binary-size(32),
           token_mac::binary-size(@mac_length)>> <- token do
      now = :os.system_time(:second)
      payload = binary_part(token, 0, 40)
      expected_mac = compute_mac(channel.mac_key, payload)

      cond do
        not secure_compare(token_mac, expected_mac) -> {:error, :invalid_token}
        now - timestamp > max_age_seconds -> {:error, :token_expired}
        timestamp > now + 60 -> {:error, :token_from_future}
        true -> :ok
      end
    else
      _ -> {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end
end
